about_the_game:
Become the Cryptid Keeper.

Presenting the Cryptid Keeper Demo - 30 Minutes of Gameplay ahead of it's 2026 full release.

Just you, the wilderness, and things that shouldn’t exist!

Track, catch, and collect cryptids and aliens. Manage your own Cryptid Zoo, care for your creatures, and attract visitors while exploring the wild to discover new and mysterious Cryptid species add to your Index!

Gameplay :

At it's core, a Monster Collector, but with so much more...

  • Embark on a curious adventure from your base-camp, where you'll radar-scan and hunt for Cryptids, Monsters and Aliens!

  • View and manage your Cryptid Index, craft hunting resources, view your Zoo stats and more...

  • Use traps, radar pings and keen observation skills to track down and capture these elusive creatures.

Why? To add them to your Zoo of course! Open the gates, charge the visitors, maintain, feed, store and display your Cryptids.

  • Don't forget to sort your Aliens in the Cosmos Center, making sure they have the correct atmosphere for their enclosures, enough food in their bellies to keep them co-operative!

    Key Features:

    • Cryptid Hunting: Scan and search for cryptids, then find them on the Map.

    • Customise Your Zoo: Capture cryptids and house them in your very own charming zoo.

    • Collection & Discovery:  Find new cryptids and uncover their unique traits and behaviours. Explore the map, stumble upon strange encounters, investigate your radar-pings, set and bait traps, visit enterable locations, pick berries and leaves to craft items, find hunter caches and scavenge items, get ambushed by a Sasquatch... What will you find?

      Get ready to embark on a fun journey through the world of cryptids! The creatures are waiting for you to find them. Can you capture them all?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Dual-Core CPU, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5-6600K Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
